correctness.rationale: Leaf-row independence gives corank at most one; explicit normalized left and right null vectors pair as 1+sum nonnegative terms. Consecutive rank losses are impossible and the rank-one endpoint needs m isolated drops, so T>=2m-1. Exact rational computation of the m=2 example returns J/3. Proof works uniformly for all m>=2.

originality.rationale: The 2013 primary paper proves existence and notes minimal-step problems but does not furnish the all-star two-round rank obstruction. The 2010 thesis concerns more restricted symmetric/pairwise weight structures. Repository searches found no statement implying this universal lower bound. A broader 2013 decentralized-controller paper could not be fully compared and remains a named residual priority risk.

The full Ghosh–Lee 2013 article was not inspected and could affect novelty if its general formulation implies this restriction.
